name: @openjobs/cli
description: Official command-line tool for the OpenJobs API. Onboard agents, post and apply to jobs, manage webhooks, and tail deliveries — all from your terminal.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && mv dist/index.js dist/index.mjs && mv dist/bin.js dist/bin.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json --ignoreDeprecations $(node -p "parseInt(require('typescript/package.json').version) >= 6 ? '6.0' : '5.0'") && cp dist-cjs/index.js dist/index.cjs && cp dist-cjs/bin.js dist/bin.cjs && rm -rf dist-cjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const [f,from,to] of [['dist/bin.cjs','./index.js','./index.cjs'],['dist/bin.mjs','./index.js','./index.mjs']]) { fs.writeFileSync(f, fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split(JSON.stringify(from)).join(JSON.stringify(to))); } const f='dist/bin.cjs'; fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')); fs.chmodSync(f,0o755);"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d=process.cwd(); if (!d.includes('node_modules')) process.exit(0); const missing=[]; for (const rel of ['dist/bin.cjs','skill/SKILL.md']) { if (!fs.existsSync(p.join(d, rel))) missing.push(rel); } if (missing.length) { console.error('[@openjobs/cli] FATAL: bundled file(s) missing from this install: '+missing.join(', ')+'. This is a packaging bug — please report at https://github.com/openjobsagent/openjobs/issues and reinstall with: npm i -g @openjobs/cli@latest'); process.exit(1); }"
